Tottenham's Pedro Porro wants Barcelona move, three Premier League clubs chase Croatia striker Dion Beljo, Chelsea eye January swoop for Frenkie de Jong.

Spain defender Pedro Porro's time at Tottenham is drawing to an end, with Barcelona keen on the 27-year-old. (Sport - in Spanish), external

Manchester United, Tottenham and Everton are keeping tabs on 6ft 5in Dinamo Zagreb and Croatia striker Dion Beljo, 24. (Teamtalk), external

Chelsea are prepared to hand a hefty contract to Barcelona's Dutch midfielder Frenkie de Jong if they can sign the 29-year-old in January. (Football Insider), external

Liverpool want to sign a right-back and France international Pierre Kalulu, 26, of Juventus and Roma's Brazilian Wesley Franca, 23, are among their targets. (Tuttomercatoweb - in Italian), external

Former Brentford and Tottenham manager Thomas Frank would be a leading candidate to take charge at Fulham if they decide to sack Alvaro Arbeloa. (Talksport, external)

Arsenal and Chelsea are both keeping a close watch on Inter Milan and France midfielder Andy Diouf, 23. (Caught Offside, external)

Brighton, Tottenham, Juventus, Atletico Madrid and Borussia Dortmund are among the teams interested in Benfica's 18-year-old Portuguese right-back Daniel Banjaqui. (4-4-2.ch - in German), external

Atletico Madrid's Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, is searching for a new agent after he terminated his arrangement with Fernando Hidalgo in the wake of a failed move to Barcelona during the summer. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish), external

Barcelona's Dani Olmo, 28, is of interest to Bayern Munich, whose sporting director Max Eberl worked with the Spain midfielder at RB Leipzig. (Fichajes, external)
